item.title: 26.11.2019 MUSIAD Belgium organised a seminar on hiring overseas workers
item.description: MUSIAD Belgium organised a seminar in Antwerpen to discuss matters like conditions for hiring overseas workers and staff, working in subcontracting companies, among others. item.title: 24.11.2019 – MUSIAD Belgium celebrated Teachers Day at the Turkish Embassy
item.description: On the occasion of Teachers Day on Sunday, 24th November 2019, the Turkish Education Counsellor in Brussels held a programme at the Turkish Embassy in Brussels, in which the Turkish Consulate General in Antwerpen and Brussels, and many teachers took part too. In the programme, MUSIAD Belgium provided catering services to the participants.
